title: HTTP/1.1 vs HTTP/2: Asset Completion Times

sequence.caption: HTTP/1.1: Two FIFO connections block assets in queue
HTTP/2: One connection, all assets progress together
Asset c finishes at 3 units (HTTP/1.1) but 1 unit (HTTP/2) — 2 units faster
Asset d finishes at 4 units (HTTP/1.1) but 1 unit (HTTP/2) — 3 units faster
Asset f finishes at 5 units (HTTP/1.1) but 1 unit (HTTP/2) — 4 units faster

sequence.note: HTTP/1.1 total: 5 units. HTTP/2 total: 3 units. Multiplexing saves 2 units (40% faster)
